source_mode: Diagnostic rotation of an existing licensed character rig; no new geometry or pixels authored

mode_inference_decision.rationale: Offline 3D pose review screenshots only; no publishable output

source_brief: Test whether hand-long-axis rotation improves distributed pad support after two fixed-anchor fits failed.
alpha_policy: Opaque diagnostic screenshots; chroma key inapplicable.
requirements: One measurement per prescribed pose; only hands.l.palmRoll changes in absolute radians about posed targetLong, not the gun barrel.
Freeze primary fitted finger/body/right-hand commands, weapon matrix, right wrist, left palm world anchor/target, source topology, skin weights, local positions/scales and parentage.
Left wrist and elbow transforms may change through existing IK; palm center/target drift must remain at most 0.000002m.
Do not run or import an optimizer, change anchors, refit fingers, change the prescribed grid, export candidates, or modify any sealed packet.
Each long finger requires two reviewed phalange patches, each with3 unique vertices and2 faces within1.5mm, opposing normals<=-0.5 and nearest signed distance>=-0.25mm.
Measure actual reviewed pad vertices against actual weapon faces, including normal, face ID and negative nearest-face diagnostics; signed nearest face is not a containment proof.
Measure all hand/gun, inter-finger, arm/gun, torso/gun and left forearm/torso sampled crossings; full skin/coplanar containment remains outside this subset.
Use actual palm-to-weapon face normals. skinNormalAngle uses a rotating wantedNormal and cannot prove agreement with the fixed gun surface.
Zero pose must reproduce the sealed primary reach result; unsolved poses must be marked unavailable without screenshots of the previous pose.
Capture inner/top/bottom/upper views and independently inspect natural wrap, wrist distortion, support and clipping.
After these five poses stop this orientation study. Numerical improvement or a subset pass is not runtime or CS2-quality approval.
One extra zero-reference measurement for serialization guard correction only. No negative-angle repetition, new angle, search or gate relaxation.
